source.sourceText: Wake up at 7 AM after setting alarm
Opa sits up in bed, staring at a bedside clock whose hour hand is moving backward past 6, while the alarm hand points to 7.
The clock's hands move backward whenever the alarm is set, so time appears to run in reverse; the alarm rings only when the hands return to midnight.
Opa sets alarm for 7:00, the hour hand starts cranking counterclockwise.

references.sourceText: Noah closes and reopens the fridge, hoping for the normal interior.
Now the interior is a tropical rainforest with waterfalls; a pineapple rolls out.
Each opening cycles through random biome, never the kitchen fridge.
Noah reaches in past the environment to feel for the milk carton.
His hand comes back holding a coconut, and the rainforest interior shuts around his arm, trapping him briefly.
Objects inside are real and can interact, but not his groceries.
Noah holds the door open and waits, watching the interior change.
